scope.public_semantic_and_expanded_title_fonts: Debug/Release raw exports and summary table agree

accepted_reference: Twelve fixed profile sizes/weights and separate first-line boxes/line advances as measured in this native environment.
Expanded navigation uses measured largeTitle bold, independently from document title. Header headline and Button/Toggle body preserve observed pixels in the bounded large/accessibility1 matrix.
limitations: Reference measurement only: neither current native renderer consumes a new shared recipe.

Proposed Android preference normalization is not accepted here. In particular scalar values beyond available profile anchors must not silently cap an unsupported accessibility request; root must freeze an explicit supported mapping before implementation.
Contextual equivalence at the other ten profiles, other fonts/scripts/OS settings, native Android conversion/glyphs/input/accessibility and physical parity remain pending.
First-line box and repeated-line advance are distinct; neither is a universal clipping bound.
No signed installed-resource/display/health, immutable published FieldLog, store/customer/operational or GA acceptance.
